reason: E1 shows interstitials increase SFE and relieve stress in a medium-entropy alloy, but not in refractory HEAs; E2 confirms twinning and dislocation slip under dynamic loading in one HEA, but not the effect of interstitials; E3 supports chemistry-driven twinning for strength–ductility, but not via interstitials. The key premise that trace interstitials in refractory HEAs will promote twinning and uniform ductility under dynamic loading is not directly supported by the cited evidence.
